title: Shop-vac hose adapter (32 mm port to 35 mm cuff)
prompt: Adapter so my shop-vac hose fits the dust port on my sander. One end is a sleeve that slides over the sander's 32 mm port: 32.4 mm inside, 2 mm wall, 30 mm long. The other end is a 35 mm OD spigot that pushes into the hose cuff: 2 mm wall, 30 mm long. Join them with a 10 mm long conical transition, keeping the 2 mm wall, so it's 70 mm long overall.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
36.4 mm across the sleeve, 70 mm long, ±0.1 mm
Four cylindrical faces: sleeve and spigot, inside and outside
The transition is conical inside and outside (two cone faces)
Two flat annular end faces: it's a tube, open at both ends
Volume π·(68.8·30 + 202.2·10/3 + 66·30) ≈ 14822 mm³ ±1% (a 32.0 sleeve or a 34 mm spigot is off by >3%)

notes: Sleeve: r 16.2–18.2; spigot: r 15.5–17.5; frustum shells for the taper: π·h/3·(R1²+R1R2+R2²) outer minus inner.
